subject: Success story briefing: Brightlane Health — scheduling & consent
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@brightlanehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Success story briefing: Brightlane Health — scheduling & consent

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for agreeing to participate in a customer success spotlight for Brightlane Health. We want to keep this light and valuable for your team: the goal is a 30–40 minute conversation to capture outcomes, workflow changes, and a few quotes for a short written success story and a 3–4 minute video clip.

Proposed agenda (30–40 min):
- 5m quick intros and context
- 15–20m discussion: problem, why Redwood, roll-out highlights, measurable outcomes (latency/cost/ops)
- 5–10m impact examples and quotes
- 5m logistics: approvals, recording consent, and next steps

Could you confirm the right stakeholders from your side and whether the week of Mar 2 or Mar 9 works? We can also record the call for editing purposes if you’re comfortable — we’ll only use clips you explicitly approve. I’ve attached a short one-pager and a recording consent form for review.

Optional slots we can offer:
- Tue Mar 3: 10:00–10:40 PT
- Wed Mar 4: 14:00–14:40 PT
- Thu Mar 12: 09:00–09:40 PT

If none of these work, tell us a couple of windows that do and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks — excited to tell Brightlane’s story.

Evelyn Hart
Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_case_study_onepager.pdf, recording_consent_form.docx

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@brightlanehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@brightlanehealth.com>, Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@brightlanehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Success story briefing: Brightlane Health — scheduling & consent

Hi Evelyn —

Appreciate the clear agenda. We’d be happy to do this; below are the folks who should join from our side:
- Rajiv Menon — Head of Data Platforms (primary technical / deployment owner)
- Ana Gomez — Product Lead, Clinical Ops (end-user perspective)
- Emily Chen — Director of Analytics (customer contact)

We can do Tue Mar 3 at 10:00 PT — that slot works best for the team. Recording consent: we generally allow recordings for marketing as long as clips are approved before publication. I reviewed the attached consent form and it looks fine; I’ll confirm with Legal and reply if they request edits.

One quick ask: could you share a short list of example questions so we can prep Rajiv with numbers (latency improvements, token/unit cost changes) ahead of the call?

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Chen
Director of Analytics
Brightlane Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@brightlanehealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@brightlanehealth.com>, Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@brightlanehealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Success story briefing: Brightlane Health — scheduling & consent

Hi Emily — great, Mar 3 at 10:00 PT is locked on our side. I’ve sent a calendar invite (link below) and added a short prep doc to a shared Drive folder with the sample question set Evelyn mentioned.

Sample prep/questions (we’ll keep these conversational):
1) Briefly describe the challenge Brightlane faced before Redwood.
2) Why did you choose Redwood over alternatives (cost, latency, ease of integration)?
3) Can you share the biggest measurable benefit post-launch (e.g., average inference latency, cost per relevant request, reduction in infra ops time)?
4) Any surprising wins or learnings during rollout?
5) Which teams use the outputs and how has operator experience changed?
6) Any metrics you’re comfortable sharing publicly?

Logistics:
- Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=brightlane-spotlight-20260227
- Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCaseStudyAssets
- Recording: we’ll capture audio + video on Zoom and share any clips for approval.
- Attachments: redwood_case_study_onepager.pdf (overview), recording_consent_form.docx (please sign/return if needed)

Evelyn and I will be on the call; Monica will join to take notes and follow up on approvals. If Legal needs to sign a version of the consent doc, please loop them in and we’ll expedite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

-Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
